items.basis: Missed a third internal deadline (DeepMind reportedly rebuilt the base model over weak coding/hallucination). Still absent from the AA leaderboard (top Google entry is Gemini 3.5 Flash). Polymarket now leans Aug 7 (~73%), July 30 (~71%).
Polymarket prices GPT-6 a late-2026 story (~68% by Dec 31, ~40% by Sep 30, ~2% near-term); OpenAI's line still flows through the GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna) and GPT-Live voice.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus ~95% by Aug 31, ~98% by Oct 31, version unannounced.
xAI (now SpaceXAI) shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term. The 6T V9-foundation model is reportedly still training on Colossus 2, public access likely slipping to Q3+.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is reportedly targeted for Jul 24 2026 per DeepSeek's developer notes — now four days out.
